name: Himawari no Natsu ~Boku ga Eranda Ashita~
original_name: ひまわりの夏 ～僕が選んだ明日～
source:
Main character confesses to his classmate Mayu, and they start dating.
Three months later protagonist meets another girl Mayu who can't find her parents. For the time being hero shelters her at his place. As he starts to ask around, his girlfriend Mayu changes appearance somehow. What's the connection between these two Mayu girls?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公向同班同学Mayu告白，两人由此开始交往。
三个月后，主人公遇见了另一个找不到父母的Mayu。他暂时将她安置在自己家中。随着主人公开始四处打听消息，他的女友Mayu却不知为何逐渐变了模样。这两个名叫Mayu的女孩之间究竟有何联系？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
